provenance.notes: Map-site rules compiled from the official master reference sheet (p.1-2) and rulebook site sections (MKUE Rulebook p.8-11, p.14). All wording is our own short paraphrase; the physical Site Description cards were not available. Values marked null are not stated in our extracted sources.
provenance.official_cross_check: MKUE Walkthrough p.4: 'There are 14 Site Description cards' in the base game.

items.name: Village
interaction: recruit units with the village icon
special: plunder during another player's turn: draw 2 cards, Reputation -1, at most once between your turns
items.official_ref: MK Master Reference Sheet p.1 (VILLAGE); MKUE Rulebook p.8

items.name: Monastery
interaction: recruit units with the monastery icon
buy the Advanced Action in the Units offer for 6 influence (training)
special: when revealed, put the top Advanced Action in the Units offer (training)
burning (action): Reputation -3, fight a random violet enemy without Units; if defeated, mark with a shield and gain an Artifact; monastery becomes destroyed
items.official_ref: MK Master Reference Sheet p.1 (MONASTERY); MKUE Rulebook p.8-9

items.name: Mage Tower

garrison.reveal: revealed during the Day if a player is adjacent

interaction: buy Spells for 7 influence plus one mana matching the Spell's colour
special: defenders are fortified; unclaimed tower can be assaulted with Reputation -1
items.official_ref: MK Master Reference Sheet p.1 (MAGE TOWER); MKUE Rulebook p.8-9

items.name: Keep

garrison.reveal: revealed during the Day if a player is adjacent

interaction: recruit units with the keep icon (owner only)
hand limit +1 while on or adjacent to a keep you own
special: defenders are fortified
assaulting another player's keep: if the owner is absent draw a random gray token as fortified defenders; success gives half Fame (rounded up) and replaces their shield
items.official_ref: MK Master Reference Sheet p.1 (KEEP); MKUE Rulebook p.8-9

items.name: Magical Glade
special: healing essence: if you end your turn here, discard one Wound card from hand or discard pile (not Healing, does not combine with Healing effects)
imbued with magic: starting your turn here during Day gives a gold mana token; during Night a black mana token
items.official_ref: MK Master Reference Sheet p.1 (MAGICAL GLADE)

items.name: Crystal Mine
interaction: mining: ending your turn on a mine gives one mana crystal of the colour it produces
special: each mine tile is printed with its crystal colour; see tiles.json hex.mine_color
items.official_ref: MK Master Reference Sheet p.1 (CRYSTAL MINES); MKUE Rulebook p.8

items.name: Deep Mine
interaction: mining: ending your turn on a deep mine gives one mana crystal of any colour it produces
special: expansion tile site; produces multiple colours
items.official_ref: MK Master Reference Sheet p.2 (DEEP MINES)

items.name: Ancient Ruins
special: when revealed place a yellow token face up during Day, face down during Night (revealed at next Day start or when entered)
enter as an action: either an altar (pay 3 mana of the token's colour: shield + 7 Fame) or fight the enemies depicted on the token
undefeated enemies stay and can be fought later; clearing the last enemy gives the token's reward
stretch content in v1 (see docs/design/11-mvp-scope.md)
items.official_ref: MK Master Reference Sheet p.1 (ANCIENT RUINS)

items.name: Dungeon
special: enter as an action: reveal a brown enemy token and fight it under Night rules without Units
reward roll a mana die: gold/black gives a Spell, otherwise an Artifact
conquered dungeons can be re-entered for Fame only (no reward, no new shield)
items.official_ref: MK Master Reference Sheet p.1 (DUNGEON)

items.name: Tomb
special: enter as an action: draw a red Draconum token and fight under Night rules without Units
defeat: shield + one Spell + one Artifact; if defeated, discard the enemy token
conquered tombs can be re-entered for Fame only (no reward, no new shield)
items.official_ref: MK Master Reference Sheet p.1 (TOMB)

items.name: Monster Den
special: enter as an action: draw one brown enemy token; undefeated token stays face up for the next entrant
reward: shield + two crystals decided by rolling a mana die twice (gold: choose; black: Fame +1 instead)
items.official_ref: MK Master Reference Sheet p.1 (MONSTER DEN)

items.name: Spawning Grounds
special: enter as an action: draw and fight two brown enemy tokens
undefeated tokens remain; defeated ones are replaced by a new face-down brown token
reward: shield + one Artifact + three crystals decided by mana die rolls (gold: choose; black: Fame +1 instead)
items.official_ref: MK Master Reference Sheet p.1 (SPAWNING GROUNDS)

items.name: City

garrison.reveal: entire garrison revealed when attacking from an adjacent space

interaction: after conquest the city can be entered; it offers unit recruitment and card purchase options depending on the city colour
special: four cities exist (green/blue/white/red); city level sets garrison count
garrison is fortified; cooperate/assault rules differ (MKUE Rulebook p.13)
city cards carry additional combat bonuses to their garrison; exact card text not in our extracted sources (null)
v1 MVP uses a single level-4 city
items.official_ref: MKUE Rulebook p.8-10, p.13; MK Master Reference Sheet (city rules referenced via site cards)

items.name: Portal
special: starting space at the centre of the starting tile; heroes begin here on their first turn
items.official_ref: MKUE Rulebook p.3 (Map / starting tile)

items.name: Marauding Orcs
special: when revealed place a green Orc token face up on this space
nobody can enter the space while the Orcs are there; they can be provoked by moving between adjacent spaces, or challenged from an adjacent space as an action
defeating them discards the token and gives Reputation +1
items.official_ref: MK Master Reference Sheet p.1 (MARAUDING ORCS)

items.name: Draconum
special: when revealed place a red Draconum token face up on this space
nobody can enter the space while it is there; can be provoked or challenged like Marauding Orcs
defeating it discards the token and gives Reputation +2
items.official_ref: MK Master Reference Sheet p.1 (DRACONUM)

items.name: Refugee Camp
interaction: recruit Units; for recruitment it may be treated as any depicted site, with cost increases for more advanced sites
special: expansion site; choose the cheapest valid recruiting option
items.official_ref: MK Master Reference Sheet p.2 (REFUGEE CAMP)

items.name: Maze
special: enter as an action; only one ready unwounded Unit may accompany you
pay 2, 4 or 6 Move to choose a path, then draw and fight a brown enemy token (discarded afterwards either way)
reward by move paid: two crystals of your choice / a Spell / an Artifact; mark the path conquered
a second player must choose another path; each path can be conquered once
items.official_ref: MK Master Reference Sheet p.2 (MAZE)

items.name: Labyrinth
special: like the Maze but the enemy is a red Draconum token and every path reward also includes an Advanced Action
items.official_ref: MK Master Reference Sheet p.2 (LABYRINTH)

items.name: Volkare's Camp
special: Lost Legion scenario site used only by the Volkare scenarios; rules live in the expansion scenario book which we do not have
items.official_ref: upstream mk-data/sites.rs (no official text in our extracted sources)
